purpose: GRF-09's pass condition, locked before any measurement exists (D-05, the GRF-01 protocol). tools/graphcluster reads every value here — corpus, metrics.clusteringTimeMs (max, statistic, runs), minNodes and onFailure — rather than carrying its own defaults. Amending, widening or relaxing any value in this file after tools/graphcluster measures against it is forbidden; on FAIL the remedy is onFailure (index-time persistence into Node field 50, community_id), never a raised bar.

corpus.note: SHA copied verbatim from corpora/manifest.json, the sole pin authority. The largest locally indexed corpus at file-rollup scale (3,233 file nodes / 21,554 file-pair edges per GRF-01). The harness opens the already-indexed store under ~/.cache/codegraph/corpora/ READ-ONLY and never re-indexes it.

clusteringTimeMs.definition: Elapsed wall-clock time of one AssignCommunities(nodes, edges) call over the FileGraphResult rollup of the pinned corpus — from the rollup being complete (FileGraph() returned) to the community assignment map being complete — measured in-process by tools/graphcluster, truncated to integer milliseconds from time.Duration, over `runs` cold calls (a fresh store snapshot and a fresh FileGraph() per run; no cache, no warm-up call excluded, no GC forced between runs), binding statistic the median (the sorted middle value, never an average). PASS iff median <= max; equality passes. The comparison is integer-only: no floats anywhere in the verdict path.

minNodesNote: The harness REFUSES (exit 2, no observation written) when the pinned corpus resolves to fewer than 2 file nodes — a 0 ms observation over an empty rollup is not a meaningful PASS.

fileGraphWallMs.definition: Recorded, never a bar: total FileGraph() wall time per run, includes one embedded clustering pass; recorded so the split between scan cost and clustering cost stays visible.

nodeCount.definition: Recorded, never a bar: the number of file-level nodes in the measured rollup.

edgeCount.definition: Recorded, never a bar: the number of aggregated file-pair edges in the measured rollup.

communityCount.definition: Recorded, never a bar: the number of distinct community ids the measured run assigned.

measurementProtocol.storeSource: the cached corpus store resolved through corpora/manifest.json + internal/corpora.Entry.Dir + .codegraph/store, opened with graphstore.Open + Snapshot, never indexer.Run
measurementProtocol.runsNote: The binding run count lives once, at metrics.clusteringTimeMs.runs — not duplicated here, so there is exactly one number to keep in sync.
measurementProtocol.comparison: PASS iff median <= max; equality passes
measurementProtocol.observationCarriesThresholdDigestNote: The observation records a sha256 of this file's bytes so a later edit to this file is detected by a persisted test.
measurementProtocol.ancestryProof: tools/graphcluster/ancestry_test.go — the commit that added this file must be an ancestor (or the same commit, after a squash-merge) of every commit touching the observation file and the harness

onFailure: If clusteringTimeMs.median exceeds max, the observation records verdict FAIL verbatim and the phase executes the documented fallback: community assignment is PROMOTED to an index-time computation persisted on the file-kind Node record as int32 community_id = 50 (the first number of internal/schema/graph.proto's reserved 50-59 range), written in the indexer's commit batch and read back by FileGraph() IN PLACE OF the fresh per-call compute, which is removed — one source of truth, never two. Lowering, widening or re-scoping this threshold is NOT an available remedy.
lockedBy: 11-01-PLAN.md Task 1 (D-05); committed alone as the phase's first commit, before internal/query/community.go, tools/graphcluster or any web/src change exists.
prohibitions: MUST NOT amend, widen, or relax any value in this file after tools/graphcluster measures against it.
MUST NOT judge GRF-09 against any value not present in this committed artifact.
